motion.name: ease-broadcast
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for every transition (180-240 ms).

motion.name: copy-wipe
motion.purpose: Signature red COPIED wipe on the code row; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Copy Button
components.description: The primary action: copy the share code.
components.css: .ds-btn-copy { background: #D7262F; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-copy:hover { background: #B51C25; } .ds-btn-copy:active { background: #9C1820; } .ds-btn-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7262F; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-copy:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Console Copy Button
components.description: Secondary action: copy the console commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #111214; color: #ECEDEF; border: none; border-left: 1px solid #30343A; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ECEDEF; color: #111214; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7262F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Search a player, team or creator.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Search a CS2 player, team or creator...">
components.css: .ds-input { height: 42px; width: 360px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #30343A; border-radius: 2px; background: #1B1D21; color: #ECEDEF; font: 15px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #D7262F; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9DA2AA; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #D7262F; }

components.name: Tab Rail
components.description: Pros / Creators / Trending / Generator / Pro Skins.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #30343A; background: #111214; } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 10px 18px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; background: transparent; color: #9DA2AA; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #1B1D21; color: #ECEDEF; } .ds-tab.ds-on { background: #ECEDEF; color: #111214; } .ds-tab.ds-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 3px; background: #D7262F; }

components.name: Player Spotlight Card
components.description: Signature card: team slab, meta line, crosshair stat box, code row.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; background: #1B1D21; border: 1px solid #30343A; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #ECEDEF; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #2ECC71; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-slab { height: 96px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 12px 16px; background: #2ECC71; color: #0B0C10; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); clip-path: polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 16px),calc(100% - 16px) 100%,0 100%); } .ds-slab h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 32px/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px 0; font: 600 13px Inter, sans-serif; color: #9DA2AA; } .ds-meta span:last-child { font: 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; } .ds-stat { position: relative; height: 80px; margin: 10px 16px 0; background: #08090A; border: 1px solid #30343A; } .ds-stat span { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 8px; padding: 2px 6px; background: rgba(7,8,10,0.78); color: #D7262F; font: 600 11px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row { display: flex; margin: 10px 16px 16px; border: 1px solid #30343A; background: #24272C; } .ds-row code { flex: 1; min-width: 0; align-self: center; padding: 0 10px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font: 500 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-row button { border: none; background: #D7262F; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 9px 16px; font: 600 13px Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Game Switch
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #30343A; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-switch button { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; background: #1B1D21; color: #9DA2AA; font: 600 13px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-switch .ds-on { background: #ECEDEF; color: #111214; } .ds-switch button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-switch small { font: 600 11px Inter, sans-serif; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }

narrative.overview: ClutchCrosshair looks like the graphics package of a CS Major broadcast, applied to a working tool. Charcoal ground (~70%), deep grey cards (~25%), one signature red for actions (~5%). Barlow Condensed for headings and player names only, Inter for the interface, JetBrains Mono for codes. The home page opens on a compact navigation, a strong title, a large search and three quick-access tiles, then the grid.
keyCharacteristics: Team-colour slabs with chamfered corners as the identity of every player.
Charcoal 70%, deep grey 25%, signature red 5%; yellow only from teams.
Condensed display type for headings only; Inter for the interface; mono for codes.
Flat panels divided by 1px seams; no glows, no gradient text.
The crosshair preview is always drawn at true in-game size.

rules.name: The Five Percent Rule
rules.body: Red covers roughly 5% of any screen: actions, the selection and thin interaction lines. It is never a large fill and never decoration.

rules.name: The No Second Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no second interface accent. Yellow, green and cyan belong to teams and crosshairs.

rules.name: The Brand Marks Rule
rules.body: Social icons always show their official colours: Discord in brand-discord, TikTok white (black in light mode) with its cyan and pink offset, X white (black in light mode).

rules.name: The Variables Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour, family, size, weight and line height comes from a CSS variable on :root or body.light. Nothing is hard-coded inside a component.

rules.name: The Headlines Only Rule
rules.body: The condensed face is only for headings and player names. Controls, labels and text are always Inter.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No halos, glows or gradient text. Depth comes from tone and seams.

dos: Do keep red at about 5% of the screen: actions, selection, thin interaction lines.
Do use the condensed face only for headings and player names.
Do read every colour and type setting from a CSS variable.
Do draw the crosshair preview at true in-game size.
donts: Don't reintroduce yellow or amber as an interface accent.
Don't add a marketing banner, a long slogan or decorative motion to the home hero.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use glows, gradient text or glassmorphism.
